definitions.canonical_expression: q_N=sum_{alpha=1}^{2} c_dagger[N,alpha]*c[N,alpha]-1; Q_lat=sum_{N=0}^{4} q_N; S_ell=sum_{N=0}^{ell} q_N
E_-1=-(g/2)*Q_lat; E_ell=g*(S_ell-Q_lat/2) for ell=0,...,3; E_4=(g/2)*Q_lat; G_N=E_N-E_{N-1}-g*q_N=0 for N=0,...,4
definitions.display_latex: E_{-1}=-\frac g2Q_{\rm lat},\quad E_\ell=g\left(S_\ell-\frac12Q_{\rm lat}\right),\quad E_4=\frac g2Q_{\rm lat},\quad G_N=E_N-E_{N-1}-gq_N=0

definitions.canonical_expression: H_lat=sum_{N=0}^{4} c_dagger_N*((m+r/a)*beta)*c_N + sum_{N=0}^{3}[c_dagger_N*(-i*alpha/(2a)-r*beta/(2a))*c_{N+1}+c_dagger_{N+1}*(i*alpha/(2a)-r*beta/(2a))*c_N] + (a*g^2/2)*sum_{ell=0}^{3}(S_ell-Q_lat/2)^2; alpha=sigma_3; beta=sigma_1; a=1; g=0.5; m=0.5; r=1

definitions.display_latex: \mathsf P c_N\mathsf P^{-1}=\beta c_{4-N},\qquad \mathsf P E_\ell\mathsf P^{-1}=-E_{3-\ell}
\mathsf T c_N\mathsf T^{-1}=\beta c_N,\qquad \mathsf T i\mathsf T^{-1}=-i

definitions.canonical_expression: s(k)=k+2; A0_N(t)=exp(i*H_lat*t)*A0_N*exp(-i*H_lat*t); U_k=exp(-i*g*a*A0_{s(k)}(k*a)); W_z=U_{z-1}...U_0 for z>0, identity for z=0, and U_z^{-1}...U_{-1}^{-1} for z<0
definitions.display_latex: U_k=\exp[-igaA_{0,s(k)}(ka)],\quad W_z=\begin{cases}U_{z-1}\cdots U_0,&z>0,\\ \mathbb I,&z=0,\\ U_z^{-1}\cdots U_{-1}^{-1},&z<0.\end{cases}

definitions.canonical_expression: O_lat(z,0)=(1/a)*c_dagger_{z+2}(z*a)*(I-sigma_3)*W_z*c_2(0), where c_N(t)=exp(i*H_lat*t)*c_N*exp(-i*H_lat*t), z in {-2,-1,0,1,2}, and W_z is oriented from X(0) to X(z)
No unitary one-site translation maps the open five-site Hamiltonian to itself because the boundary hopping terms are absent.

definitions.canonical_expression: No exact finite-lattice generator of continuous boosts or continuous spacetime translations is defined.
definitions.display_latex: M^{01}\ \text{and continuous }P^1\text{ have no exact finite-OBC lattice realization}

experience_selection.reason: No historical candidate was supplied. A cohesive OBC Wilson-fermion bundle with exact axial-gauge Gauss-law elimination was derived because it preserves the required charge-sector path without gauge truncation and has lower execution cost than full-link or PBC-holonomy formulations.

field_encodings.degrees_of_freedom: Two fermionic modes c[N,alpha] at every site, alpha=1,2; ten modes total; full Fock dimension 2^10=1024; Q_lat=0 sector dimension C(10,5)=252.
field_encodings.scheme: two-component Wilson fermions in the fixed gamma representation followed by an exact fermionic occupation encoding
field_encodings.truncation: No approximate fermion truncation: each fermionic mode has exact occupations 0 and 1; Wilson parameter r=1.

field_encodings.degrees_of_freedom: No independent gauge-link degree of freedom. Electric fields and A_0 are reconstructed from q_N, and Gauss law holds at every lattice vertex; the global sum of the vertex relations is dependent under the reflection-symmetric boundary-flux prescription. The effective reduced degree count is the ten fermionic modes.
field_encodings.scheme: spatial axial gauge A_1=0 with exact Gauss-law elimination
field_encodings.truncation: None. No electric-flux cutoff and no finite-group or quantum-link replacement.

lattice.geometry: 1+1 dimensions; five spatial sites N=0,...,4 with x_N=a*(N-2), spatial links ell=0,...,3, temporal spacing a_t=a, and observable site map s(z)=z+2
lattice.spatial_boundary_condition: open boundary conditions with reflection-symmetric boundary electric flux E_-1=-(g/2)Q_lat and E_4=(g/2)Q_lat

lattice_symmetries.commutator_result: G_N=0 as an operator identity at every lattice vertex after exact elimination; consequently [H_lat,G_N]=0.
[H_lat,Q_lat]=0 exactly in the full reduced Fock space.
P*H_lat*P^{-1}=H_lat under N->4-N and the reflection-symmetric boundary-flux reconstruction.
PT*H_lat*(PT)^{-1}=H_lat; no relation between matrix elements at z and -z is inferred.
A cyclic one-site translation does not commute with H_lat because OBC omit the wrap-around hopping and link terms.
Continuous spatial translations are not represented on the finite OBC lattice; time evolution generated by H_lat remains exact.
No exact continuous boost generator exists at finite spatial and temporal lattice spacing.
